title: rennellia elongata
intro: Rennellia elongata, commonly known as the "Elephant Ear," is a species of flowering plant in the family Gentianaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its potential to lower blood pressure, improve digestion, and reduce inflammation. Rennellia elongata is reported to have therapeutic actions such as anti-diarrheal, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, although further research is needed to fully understand its chemical composition and effects.
